question: Which of the following singers from Calcutta was the first artist from the subcontinent to record commercially on the gramophone in November 1902?
solution:
The correct answer is __Gauhar Jaan.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __key points__

__
 
• Gauhar Jan , the first artist from the subcontinent to record commercially on the gramophone in November 1902, was a diva and superstar of her time.
 
• The gramophone forerunner of the modern record player, tape and CD player. In 1877 Thomas Edison (1847–1931) invented the sound machine he called the phonograph .
 
• Kolkata-based singer Gauhar Jaan was the first Indian and Bengali artist to record her own songs, and gained instant fame.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• In 1887, Emil Berliner invented the gramophone, an improved version of Edison's phonograph.
 
• The man who introduced Bengal to the world of gramophones was FW Gaisberg, the first recording engineer of the Gramophone Company.
 
• The first entrepreneur in manufacturing and marketing gramophones was M L Shaw (Anglicized from Manick Lal Saha), originally a harmonium manufacturer.
